answer: A concrete sybil brake is a delayed-settlement haven: newcomers may publish immediately, but payouts stay frozen until older established miners attest the work. Those attestors occupy a rotating terrace of scarce grading seats, so one operator cannot staff an army of graders. When many fresh accounts share an umber stylistic fingerprint or identical admission timing, the panel slashes the frozen purse, and the loss outruns any gain from spawning clones.
